post.description:
Register a new user account.

On success:
- Creates user in database
- Publishes user.created event
- Sets __Host-nohiki_at (access token) cookie
- Sets __Host-nohiki_rt (refresh token) cookie
- Returns user metadata (does NOT return tokens in body)

Authenticate user and set auth cookies.

On success:
- Sets __Host-nohiki_at (access token) cookie
- Sets __Host-nohiki_rt (refresh token) cookie
- Returns user metadata (tokens are NOT in response body)

Refresh the access token using the refresh token cookie.

This endpoint:
- Validates the refresh token from cookie
- Rotates the refresh token (old token becomes invalid)
- Sets new __Host-nohiki_at and __Host-nohiki_rt cookies

If the same refresh token is used twice (reuse detection),
the entire session family is revoked for security.

post.description:

post.description:
Record user feedback on a correlation.

Feedback types:
- **viewed**: User viewed the job listing
- **saved**: User saved the job for later
- **applied**: User applied to the job (strongest positive signal)
- **dismissed**: User dismissed the job (negative signal)
- **liked**: User explicitly liked the match
- **disliked**: User explicitly disliked the match

Returns 202 Accepted with request_id for async completion tracking.

Submit asymmetric score feedback on a correlation.

Feedback types:
- **GOOD**: Score accurately reflects match quality
- **TOO_HIGH**: Score overstates the match (should be lower)
- **TOO_LOW**: Score understates the match (should be higher)

This feedback is used to improve the L2R model and identify low-quality listings.

Returns 202 Accepted with request_id for async completion tracking.

Submit a manual score adjustment with reasoning.

Provides richer signal than asymmetric feedback by specifying the exact
score the user believes is correct along with their reasoning.

Score range: 0.0 (completely irrelevant) to 1.0 (perfect match)

Returns 202 Accepted with request_id for async completion tracking.

AuthListingItem.description:
A single job listing item in the auth-listings API response.

Contains only the fields needed for decorative card display.
Intentionally excludes id, listing_url, description, and weight
to prevent information leakage on an unauthenticated endpoint.

``location_raw`` mirrors the underlying NOT NULL projection column;
listings without a parsable location surface as the empty string,
not ``None``.
